answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each new identity to a sequential dawn attestation window where established peers embed a unique shale-derived commitment of the candidate's prior original work. The commitment releases only after a multi-epoch cooling period; later correlation among fakes forfeits the peer's locked stake. Each attestation consumes a scarce non-parallelizable slot from the peer's reputation budget, so the marginal cost of the k-th fake rises as willing attestors shrink and the risk of a coordinated fable collapses remaining capital.
